programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including 20 Emmys and three Peabody Awards.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: It Takes a Killer
programme.desc: Some of the world's most notorious murders are the subject of "It Takes a Killer," which investigates the crimes from the perspective of the killers, trying to get inside their minds and determine their motives. Leading homicide investigators and experts from such agencies as the FBI and Scotland Yard take a look at the evidence pulled from crime scenes and profile the killer's behavior to try to piece together the details of each murder, explaining when, why and how each criminal committed the crime. For the wannabe detectives watching the show, the experts also reveal how the crime was solved -- which often requires authorities to think like a killer.

programme.title: Corrupt Crimes
programme.desc: True-crime series are a staple of the TV landscape. "Corrupt Crimes" analyzes recent criminal cases through a combination of expert testimony and dramatic storytelling. From crimes like doping in sports to more serious offenses like murder, the series exposes what is really going on in each case. Exposing corruption across the United States is the goal of the series. Cases featured in the half-hour episodes include an ATM heist that resulted in nearly $45 million being stolen worldwide and the former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Close to My Heart

programme.title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir

programme.title: Dragonwyck
programme.desc: For Miranda Wells, moving to New York to live in Dragonwyck Manor with her rich cousin, Nicholas, seems like a dream. However, the situation gradually becomes nightmarish. She observes Nicholas' troubled relationship with his tenant farmers, as well as with his daughter, to whom Miranda serves as governess. Her relationship with Nicholas intensifies after his wife dies, but his mental imbalance threatens any hope of happiness.

programme.title: Whirlpool
programme.desc: Plagued by an overwhelming urge to shoplift, Ann Sutton (Gene Tierney) is helped out of a tight spot by David Korvo (Jose Ferrer). Unfortunately for Ann, Korvo is a conniving hypnotist who draws her into a web of deception and murder through his mind-altering abilities and frames her for his misdeeds. While Ann's psychiatrist husband, Bill (Richard Conte), believes that his wife didn't commit the crimes, Korvo's devious scheme makes proving her innocence quite difficult.

programme.title: Heaven Can Wait
programme.desc: Spoiled playboy Henry van Cleve dies and arrives at the entrance to Hell, a final destination he is sure he deserves after living a life of profligacy. The devil, however, isn't so sure Henry meets Hell's standards. Convinced he is where he belongs, Henry recounts his life's deeds, both good and bad, including an act of indiscretion during his 25-year marriage to his wife, Martha, with the hope that His Excellency will arrive at the proper judgment.

programme.title: Leave Her to Heaven
programme.desc: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable.

programme.title: Night and the City
programme.desc: Londoner Harry Fabian (Richard Widmark) is a second-rate con man looking for an angle. After years of putting up with Harry's schemes, his girlfriend, Mary (Gene Tierney), becomes fed up when he taps her for yet another loan. His latest ploy, promoting an aging Greek wrestler, goes awry when the wrestler dies and everyone points the finger at Harry. Hiding out in a riverfront barge, Harry sees his grand ambitions spiral into a nightmare of fear and desperation as the underworld closes in.

programme.title: The Razor's Edge
programme.desc: An American fighter pilot, Larry Darrell (Tyrone Power), returns from World War I sickened by the violence and fighting he has witnessed. In search of meaning, he travels to Paris, where he tries to live modestly. However, this leads Larry's fiancée, the status-seeking Isabel Bradley (Gene Tierney), to break off the engagement. But Isabel returns to Larry's life when he becomes romantically involved with Sophie (Anne Baxter), a troubled alcoholic recovering from tragedy.

programme.title: Tobacco Road
programme.desc: A poor family in rural Georgia struggles to make ends meet as the clan's father, Jeeter Lester (Charley Grapewin), proudly refuses help at every turn. Although the Lesters have thrived on their land for generations, Jeeter and his wife (Marjorie Rambeau) haven't prospered, and the outlook for the family is bleak. While many Lester children have left the farm, the none-too-bright Dude (William Tracy) and the gorgeous Ellie May (Gene Tierney) are still around to cause a fair share of drama.

programme.title: Toys in the Attic
programme.desc: Black sheep Julian Berniers (Dean Martin) returns home -- along with wife Lily (Yvette Mimieux) -- to his two sisters in New Orleans. Julian's shoe factory in Illinois has gone bankrupt, but he tells them he saved enough money to be comfortable. Julian's sister, Carrie (Geraldine Page), nurses a borderline incestuous affection for Julian and dislikes Lily. When Carrie overhears Julian revealing his money was swindled from Cyrus Warkins (Larry Gates), she convinces naive Lily to betray Julian.

programme.title: Crime and Punishment, U.S.A.
programme.desc: A Santa Monica, Calif., law student (George Hamilton) kills a pawnbroker, then helps a policeman (Frank Silvera) solve the crime.

programme.title: Home From the Hill
programme.desc: For his entire life, Theron Hunnicutt's mother, Hannah, has sheltered him from the philandering of his father, Wade. Despite her best efforts, Theron acquires his father's taste for women when the elder Hunnicutt takes a sudden interest in his upbringing. When Theron unexpectedly impregnates Libby, the daughter of a local shopkeeper, he struggles with conflicted feelings about marriage and his family's legacy of infidelity.

programme.title: Angel Baby

programme.title: A Thunder of Drums

When the troops have to face fierce local Apaches, will Maddocks and McQuade be able to put their differences aside?

programme.title: Two Weeks in Another Town

Robinson). When Kruger is sidetracked by a heart attack, Andrus steps in as director and struggles to save his mentor's picture from certain failure -- even as Kruger denounces Andrus and accuses him of betrayal.

programme.title: Doctor, You've Got to Be Kidding
programme.desc: Self-centered Harlan W. Wycliff (George Hamilton) resents the fact that his secretary and lover, Heather Halloran (Sandra Dee), is pursuing a singing career. Nevertheless, Heather quickly becomes a popular attraction when she starts working as a nightclub singer for stone-faced club owner Dan Ruskin (Mort Sahl). After fainting just before an appearance, Heather learns that she's pregnant. While she's at the hospital, three suitors attempt to marry Heather and make an honest woman of her.

programme.title: The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing
programme.desc: After serving time for avenging the murder of Cat Dancing, his Native American wife, Jay Grobart (Burt Reynolds), reluctantly takes part in a train robbery in the hopes of using his share of the loot to make a better life for his two children. When his accomplices kidnap society woman Catherine Crocker (Sarah Miles), who is on the run from her violent husband (George Hamilton), Grobart's inner decency protects her from harm as they flee from the bounty hunter (Lee J. Cobb) chasing them.

programme.title: Your Cheatin' Heart

With the help of Audrey (Susan Oliver), his ambitious wife, Shorty Younger (Red Buttons), his manager, and Fred Rose (Arthur O'Connell), a music publisher, Williams gains an enthusiastic fan base and becomes a country music star. However, the pressures of success soon become too much for Williams to handle.

programme.title: Where the Boys Are
programme.desc: Beautiful Midwestern college girls Angie (Connie Francis), Melanie (Yvette Mimieux), Tuggle (Paula Prentiss) and Merritt (Dolores Hart) take off to Florida for spring break. On their search for romance and adventure, Merritt falls for the charismatic Ryder Smith (George Hamilton), while Tuggle becomes briefly involved with the somewhat dim TV Thompson (Jim Hutton). Though the young women have plenty of good times, they find that the trip isn't all fun and games.

programme.title: Light in the Piazza
programme.desc: Meg Johnson (Olivia de Havilland) is very protective of her daughter, Clara (Yvette Mimieux), a gorgeous young woman who suffers from a mental disability. While on vacation in Italy, Clara meets the dashing Fabrizio Naccarelli (George Hamilton), who is immediately smitten with her and doesn't initially grasp the extent of her developmental handicap. Though Meg is wary of letting Clara fall into a romance with Fabrizio, she realizes that he may be able to give the girl a better life.

programme.title: The Neptune Factor
programme.desc: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival.

programme.title: The Alligator People
programme.desc: Newly married nurse Joyce Webster (Beverly Garland) doesn't know what to think when her husband, Paul (Richard Crane), disappears during a train ride. She hires private investigators and eventually tracks him to an old bayou plantation, where the owner (Frieda Inescort) insists she's never heard of Paul. Joyce sticks around anyway and soon learns that local doctor Mark Sinclair (George Macready) has been using a life-altering alligator serum on the town's residents, and that Paul is among them.

programme.title: Curly Top
programme.desc: Charming, headstrong young Elizabeth Blair (Shirley Temple) lives at the Lakeside Orphanage where her sister, Mary (Rochelle Hudson), works in the kitchen. Mary writes songs that Elizabeth sings. The child's performance and her spirit impress a young, wealthy trustee, Edward Morgan (John Boles), who poses as a lawyer with an offer of adoption for Elizabeth, but she won't leave without her sister. Edward decides to bring them both to his mansion, and soon begins to fall in love with Mary.

programme.title: Wee Willie Winkie
programme.desc: With her widowed mother (June Lang), precocious Priscilla (Shirley Temple) travels to India to live with her grandfather, Col. Williams (C. Aubrey Smith). A stern officer in the British army, the colonel makes it clear that a military garrison isn't any place for a child. Priscilla proves otherwise, befriending tenderhearted Sgt. MacDuff (Victor McLaglen), getting caught up in the plot of a rebel leader (Cesar Romero) and charming everyone in sight.

programme.title: Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm
programme.desc: After Rebecca (Shirley Temple) is mistakenly rejected at an audition for a radio advertising campaign, her stepfather takes her upstate to stay at Sunnybrook Farm with her Aunt Miranda (Helen Westley), who bans her from show business. Meanwhile, advertising exec Tony Kent (Randolph Scott) desperately searches for Rebecca, who he has only heard, unaware that she's on the farm next to his. Tony's search is interrupted by many things -- including Rebecca's attractive cousin, Gwen (Gloria Stuart).

programme.title: Susannah of the Mounties
programme.desc: A Mountie (Randolph Scott) and his sweetheart (Margaret Lockwood) adopt a little girl (Shirley Temple) orphaned by an Indian attack.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another…and is after her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning…but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right….

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson stars as a radio station owner who builds a three-dimensional television receiver which accidentally intercepts a "galaxy being" whose strange form and deadly radiation triggers a tide of panic and violence!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: The Hundred Days Of The Dragon
programme.desc: In a terrifyingly timely story of genetic engineering and political power plays, Sidney Blackmer stars as a popular American President who puts into place a master plan to slowly and steadily destroy the United States. James Hong also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In order to unifying the nations of Earth, a group of scientists sets out to secretly create the ultimate, global threat -- an all-powerful alien monster -- via human mutation! Robert Culp stars as the scientist chosen to undergo the transformation.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A meek, unassuming college professor (Donald Pleasence) invents a device capable of controlling the entire electro-magnetic spectrum and realizes the device has unleashed his subconscious thirst for revenge—with uncontrollable and deadly results!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: The Man Who Was Never Born
programme.desc: Martin Landau stars as the time-traveler Andro who is desperately trying to stop the birth of a crazed 20th century inventor whose bacterium invention turns humans into hideous mutants. Shirley Knight co-stars in this classic, touching episode.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Both a cautionary tale and a tight courtroom drama, this haunting episode explores the fear and hostility that result when all privacy is eliminated...and all secrets are revealed! Jeff Corey, Peter Breck and Alan Baxter star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In an isolated, snowbound outpost where a handful of people are on alert against enemy attack, a crazed Army major (Harry Guardino) is haunted by the ghost of a soldier he left to die. Sally Kellerman co-stars in one of her earliest TV appearances.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Two rock samples in Dr. Temple's (Barry Atwater) lab conceal protoplasmic alien invaders capable of controlling a human "corpus." Enter Paul Cameron (Robert Culp)...who can telepathically hear the "rocks" plotting their take-over of the world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A six-man strike force is captured on the planet Ebon and brutally interrogated. And when they are suddenly allowed the "respect due a conquered enemy," the prisoners to conclude that there is a traitor among them...someone who must be killed!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: It Crawled Out Of The Woodwork
programme.desc: Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Film great Miriam Hopkins (1932's "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) returns to the screen to give a show-stopping performance as an overly ripe flapper who will stop at nothing to complete her long overdue wedding night scenario. John Hoyt also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In one of the series' most unnerving episodes, Don Gordon portrays a secret government agent who infiltrates the ranks of the Invisibles -- a subversive, underground society of the nation's power brokers who are possessed by alien parasites.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Martin Landau and Sally Kellerman star as an inventor and his ambitious wife in a parable about aspiration's devolution into greed when a failed experiment leads to the interception of a powerful alien being from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When four brilliant young men born and raised in Spider County suddenly vanish and a fifth is accused of a murder he didn't commit, the boy receives a unique invitation from an alien being who is willing to take him to a home very, very far away.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Ruth Roman, Alex Nicol and Tim O'Connor star in this compelling study of allegiance and sacrifice as a group of lunar astronauts discover a strange space vessel full of fugitives from another world…and they have a desperate story to tell.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Sent to investigate a strange situation on a possibly habitable planet, Dr. Evan Marshall (Larry Pennell) discovers the scientific team sent there is now dominated by a human mutant (Warren Oates) who can exist without sleep and kill by touch!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A drifter wanders into an eerie mansion and finds himself ill-at-ease amongst the eccentric cast of occupants, all of whom may just be part of some strange scientific study…from the dark recesses of the Outer Limits. Gloria Grahame stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: The politics of indoctrination are disturbingly portrayed -- and the Outer Limits is brought closer to home -- as a couple (Macdonald Carey, Marion Ross) welcome their son's new tutor into their home…a tutor whose motives may just be alien invasion!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: Production And Decay Of Strange Particles
programme.desc: An emergency at a nuclear power plant sets the wheels of man's possible destruction into horrifying motion as radiation gone wild tears open a dimensional hole in the reactor! George MacReady stars as the scientist who struggles to find a solution!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Robert Duvall stars as a CIA agent sent on a mission to infiltrate a downed space craft and kill the creatures inside. Mutated to appear as they do, he soon learns that the shape in which a man finds his own humanity is not always a human one.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Vera Miles and Barbara Rush stars as two women who kill a ruthless blackmailer. Fleeing from their crime, they stumble across an eccentric inventor (David McCallum) obsessed with returning the dead to life….including the man the women murdered.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In Harlan Ellison's first ever science fiction teleplay, Michael Ansara portrays a man born and bred to be a killing machine who finds himself without a war when a time warp sends him from a future earth to the present day. Lloyd Nolan also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Star Trek's William Shatner stars as the first man to successfully land on Venus. But when he suddenly starts craving heat -- more heat than humans can stand -- it is just the beginning of a nightmare brought back from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a rescue mission is sent to Mars to discover the fate of a doomed expedition, the Commander (Adam West) and his crew find themselves hunted by an invisible enemy who seems intent on picking them off...one at a time. Ted Knight co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A frustrated scientist (Warren Stevens) receives an offer he cannot refuse when an alien creature (Robert Webber) offers to provide him with the answers he seeks. In return, the scientist must hand over all of his human emotions...including love.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a highly dangerous and illegal alien creature escapes from scientist Henderson James' lab, he clones himself to kill the beast. But if the clone is not destroyed before James' memories set in, James may find his cozy life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a long-duration spaceflight simulation is invaded by an alien presence, the six astronauts inside begin turning on one another as the being preys on each of their darkest fears! Or is this all just part of the simulation...a test?

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A robot probe destined for Mars is in jeopardy when the disembodied brain meant to control it discovers that it now has the ability to control...or to destroy. Grant Williams, Elizabeth Perry, Anthony Eisley, Douglas Kennedy and Peter Hansen star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A downed fighter pilot (Dewey Martin) and his wife (Mary Murphy) find themselves stuck in a different dimension where time is frozen whilst life in the real world travels on...towards a tragedy they want desperately to avert.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a cargo plane carrying five passengers is downed in the eye of a hurricane, the passengers find themselves trapped in an eerily cavernous chamber and dependent upon the "human" compassion of their alien captors for survival. Mark Richman stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.desc: El sacrificio de Piccolo y la oportuna intervención de Gohan y Klilyn permiten a Goku completar el Genkidama y lanzarlo contra su enemigo. Incapaz de resistir el impacto directo, Freeza desaparece en la explosión resultante.
programme.sub-title: ¡El superpoder destructivo del Genkidama! ¿Quién puede sobrevivir a él?

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando Goku y sus amigos ya celebraban la victoria, Freeza reaparece, deja malherido a Piccolo y asesina a Klilyn. La explosión de rabia por la muerte de su amigo hace que Goku se transforme en el Super Saiyan legendario.
programme.sub-title: ¡Al fin se transforma! Son Goku, el Super Saiyan legendario

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Una intensa rabia ha despertado al implacable guerrero de la leyenda en el pacífico y tranquilo corazón de Goku. Al reanudarse la lucha, Freeza descubre horrorizado que el Super Saiyan es superior a él en todos los aspectos.
programme.sub-title: ¡Explosión de rabia! Goku venga las muertes de todos

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Incapaz de hacer nada contra el Super Saiyan, Freeza dirige su ataque contra el planeta Namek. Una bola de energía directa al núcleo convierte la batalla en una lucha contrarreloj de cinco minutos antes de la destrucción total del planeta.
programme.sub-title: ¡¿La destrucción del planeta Namek?! El rayo de luz que perfora el suelo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: A falta de sólo cinco minutos para que el planeta explote, la batalla de Namek continúa. A pesar de las advertencias de Kaioh, Goku permite que Freeza acumule la energía necesaria para alcanzar su máximo poder.
programme.sub-title: La victoria es mía... Un ataque final para la supervivencia

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La batalla entre el Super Saiyan Son Goku y Freeza al cien por cien de su poder alcanza su punto culminante. Mientras tanto, en la Tierra, Dios pide a Shenron que reviva a todos los asesinados por Freeza y los suyos en Namek.
programme.sub-title: ¡Aparece Shenron! El momento de la destrucción de Namek se aproxima

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras el plan de Kaioh sigue adelante con la resurrección del Saichoro y Polunga en Namek, Gohan siente la desaparición de la energía de su padre después del asalto final de Freeza y se apresura hacia el lugar de la batalla.
programme.sub-title: ¡Soy el hijo de Goku! Gohan regresa al campo de batalla

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku pide a sus amigos que utilicen a Polunga para trasladar a todos los que se encuentran en Namek a la Tierra a excepción de Freeza y él. Por su parte, el tirano no piensa desperdiciar la oportunidad de lograr la inmortalidad.
programme.sub-title: ¡Me quedo en este planeta! Un deseo final para la victoria

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Después de que todos sus amigos hayan sido evacuados a la Tierra, Goku libra una épica batalla contrarreloj para acabar de una vez por todas con la amenaza de Freeza y escapar de Namek antes de que el planeta explote.
programme.sub-title: ¡Acabemos de una vez! Dos luchadores permanecen en el planeta condenado

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Con Namek más cerca de su destrucción a cada segundo que pasa, Goku decide abandonar la batalla tras enseñarle a Freeza lo que es el miedo. Llevado por su arrogancia, el tirano espacia lanza un último ataque a traición.
programme.sub-title: ¡El patetismo de Freeza! Una vez comienza a temblar ya no puede parar

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Después de que Freeza caiga víctima de su propio ataque, Goku siente compasión por su enemigo y le entrega un poco de su energía para que pueda sobrevivir. Todo parece indicar que la épica batalla ha llegado a su conclusión.
programme.sub-title: ¡La declaración de victoria de Goku! Freeza se destruye a sí mismo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando parecía que todo había terminado, Freeza aprovecha la energía que le había dado Goku para lanzar un último y desesperado ataque. ¿Conseguirá Goku esquivarlo y abandonar el planeta Namek antes de que explote?
programme.sub-title: ¡Freeza derrotado! Un último ataque que concentra toda la rabia

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El Planeta Namek finalmente explota y todo parece indicar que Goku se ha visto atrapado en la explosión. La buena noticia es que según Dende las bolas de Namek pueden resucitar a alguien tantas veces como sea necesario.
programme.sub-title: ¡La gran explosión del planeta Namek! Goku desaparece en el espacio

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Ha llegado el momento de que los caídos en combate revivan gracias a las bolas de dragón. Pero el Dragón de Namek es incapaz de resucitar a Goku porque aparentemente sigue con vida. Pero si es así, ¿por qué no ha vuelto?
programme.sub-title: Goku ha sobrevivido. Todos los Guerreros Z resucitan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Una sombra demoníaca ha vuelto del averno con sed de venganza y el deseo de eliminar a todos los seres vivos del planeta. Mientras, el Todopoderoso ve menguar sus fuerzas y le ofrece su puesto a Piccolo.
programme.sub-title: ¡Algo terrible sucede en el Cielo! ¿Garlick Jr. se convierte en Dios?

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Garlick, el hijo del demonio Ajo, ha vuelto de la Zona Muerta porque desea el trono del cielo y ya ha conquistado el palacio del Todopoderoso. Con la ayuda de "La Niebla Negra", Garlick convierte a los seres humanos en demonios.
programme.sub-title: ¡La niebla oscura del terror! Todo el mundo se convierte en demonio

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La Niebla Negra de Garlick Junior ha convertido en demonios incluso al Maestro Tortuga, a Shishi, Yamcha y Bulma. ¡Son Gohan, Krilín y Piccolo se encuentran en una situación muy comprometida!
programme.sub-title: ¡Campo de batalla: el Cielo! Piccolo se convierte en demonio de nuevo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El Maestro Karin les cuenta a Son Gohan y Krilín que el Agua Ultradivina se encuentra en el palacio del Todopoderoso, pero no cuentan con un obstáculo inesperado... ¡Piccolo convertido en demonio y dispuesto a eliminarles!
programme.sub-title: ¡Confrontación directa con Piccolo! Un Masenko lleno de rabia en el Cielo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Son Gohan y Krilín apenas no pueden defenderse, ya que Garlick ha aprisionado al Todopoderoso y a Poppo y amenaza con eliminarles. Piccolo no vuelve en sí y Gohan está a punto de perder la vida...
programme.sub-title: ¡Todo el mundo debe volver en sí! El agua sagrada del Templo de Dios

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín y Piccolo han engañado a Garlick y aprovechan la confusión para robarle las botellas donde ha encerrado al Todopoderoso y a Poppo. A Poppo se le ocurre una idea para que el Agua Ultradivina cumpla su cometido.
programme.sub-title: ¡Mañana será demasiado tarde! Dios emprende una acción suicida

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El demonio Garlick se ha convertido en un poderoso gigante que recibe cada vez más poder de la Estrella de la Magia Negra. Además todos sus secuaces son ahora más peligrosos que antes y el combate se complica cada vez más.
programme.sub-title: ¡La victoria requiere medidas extremas! Dios rompe la ley sagrada

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La Estrella de la Magia Negra ya está muy cerca de la Tierra y el combate contra Garlick no tiene fin. Son Gohan es un rival muy digno, pero la inmortalidad del enemigo es el mayor problema, porque aunque le venzan, se levantará una y otra vez...
programme.sub-title: ¡El agua sagrada funciona! El mundo despierta de la pesadilla

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Después de la batalla con Garlick, los guerreros vuelven a su vida habitual. Krilín con su novia Maron, Son Gohan vuelve a sus estudios y Piccolo no cesa su vigilancia. El Maestro Tortuga les llama a todos para celebrar el cumpleaños de su tortuga
programme.sub-title: ¡Una breve posibilidad de victoria para Gohan! Derrota al mundo demoníaco

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilin busca la manera de proponerle matrimonio a Marron.
programme.sub-title: Eres un hombre ¿no?... La proposición 101ª de Krilin

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Un año después de la batalla de Namek, Gohan y sus amigos detectan una energía increíblemente poderosa y maligna que se acerca a la Tierra. Sus peores temores se confirman cuando descubren que Freeza ha sobrevivido.
programme.sub-title: Ésa es la Tierra, papá... Freeza padre e hijo contraatacan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: A falta de tres horas para que Goku regrese, la Tierra se enfrenta a la peor de las crisis en la forma de un revivido Freeza acompañado por su padre. Pero justo cuando todo parece perdido, aparece un misterioso joven que les planta cara.
programme.sub-title: Yo derrotaré a Freeza... El misterioso joven que espera a Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando Freeza y su padre aterrizan en la Tierra, lo único que se interpone entre ellos y su diabólica venganza es un muchacho desconocido. Pero el joven héroe demuestra ser más de lo que aparenta al transformarse en Super Saiyan.
programme.sub-title: ¡Freeza partido en dos de un solo golpe! Aparece otro Super Saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Tras acabar fácilmente con Freeza y su padre, el misterioso Super Saiyan anuncia el lugar y la hora exacta de llegada de Goku a la Tierra. Pero cuando Goku llega tal y como ha predicho, él tampoco parece tener ni idea de quién es el joven.
programme.sub-title: Ey, cuánto tiempo... Son Goku regresa

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El enigma que envuelve al Super Saiyan misterioso queda finalmente resuelto. Se trata de Trunks, hijo de Bulma y Vegeta, que ha viajado veinte años hacia atrás en el tiempo para advertir a Goku de una terrible amenaza que aguarda en el futuro.
programme.sub-title: Mi padre es Vegeta. La confesión del misterioso joven

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku pone a sus amigos al corriente de la profecía el joven del futuro según la cual aparecerán dos enemigos terroríficos al cabo de tres años. Todos deciden entrenarse a fondo en los tres años que faltan para la llegada de los androides.
programme.sub-title: ¿La nueva técnica especial de Goku? Mirad mi Cambio de Lugar Instantáneo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Advertidos por el joven del futuro, Goku, Piccolo, Gohan, Vegeta y el resto de Guerreros Z comienzan un duro entrenamiento de tres años para que el futuro infernal del que procede Trunks jamás llegue a hacerse realidad.
programme.sub-title: ¡Superaré a Goku! El rey de la raza guerrera saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Tras haberse enfrentado al mismísimo Freeza y haber salvado la Tierra en numerosas ocasiones, Goku se enfrenta ahora al desafío más grande de su vida: sacarse el permiso de conducir para no tener que hacer frente a la ira de Chichi.
programme.sub-title: ¿Sacarse el permiso? El nuevo desafío de Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Han pasado tres años y el día fatídico finalmente ha llegado. Tal y como había predicho Trunks, los androides aparecen y Yamcha se convierte en la primera víctima de la masacre. ¿Cuál es el terrible poder oculto de los androides?
programme.sub-title: Asesinos que no dejan rastro. ¿Quiénes son los androides?

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando los Guerreros Z finalmente localizan a los androides, el despiadado nº 20 les provoca destruyendo la mitad de la ciudad. Goku responde a los androides sorprendiéndoles con una transformación en Super Saiyan llena de rabia.
programme.sub-title: Las atrocidades del sanguinario Nº 20. La supertransformación llena de rabia de Son Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Super Saiyan Goku y el Nº 19 comienzan a librar una intensa batalla. Pero cuando Goku comienza a perder terreno y a comportarse de un modo extraño, Gohan comprende que es debido a la enfermedad cardíaca que predijo Trunks.
programme.sub-title: ¡La doble conmoción de Goku! Atrapado entre la enfermedad y la adversidad

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Afectado por una enfermedad cardíaca viral, Goku se encuentra indefenso frente al Androide Nº 19. Pero justo entonces aparece Vegeta y sorprende a todos demostrando que él también es capaz de transformarse en Super Saiyan.
programme.sub-title: ¡El poder de Vegeta! Despierta la sangre de un Super Saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: En su primera batalla como Super Saiyan, Vegeta aplasta literalmente al Nº 19, pero el Nº 20 escapa y se esconde entre las montañas. Ahora, los Guerreros Z deben encontrarle antes de que pueda llevar a cabo sus diabólicos planes.
programme.sub-title: La risa desafiante del Nº 20... El secreto del Dr. Gero

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta, Piccolo, Gohan y compañía continúan la búsqueda de un Nº 20 más dispuesto a ser el cazador que la presa. Mientras tanto, Trunks regresa a tiempo de descubrir que el pasado ha cambiado y no necesariamente para mejor.
programme.sub-title: ¿Una realidad aún más aterradora que el futuro? La sospecha de Trunks

programme.desc: Sam landet am 3. Juni 1954 im Körper des Globetrotters Phillip Dumont auf einem Kreuzfahrtschiff. Er muss an seiner Stelle versuchen, seine Ex-Frau Catherine zurückzugewinnen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam landet am 1. April 1969 in den Klamotten einer Prostituierten auf einer Straße. Als er unter Beschuss gerät, kommt ihm Robert Skaggs zur Hilfe.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam erwacht im Jahre 1957 im Körper von "Captain Galaxy" alias Moe Stein. "Captain Galaxy" mimt den Clown in einer Kindersendung. Er ist sehr schusselig, weshalb er immer wieder bei Menschen aneckt. In seinem Keller baut er an einer Zeitmaschine.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in den Körper des Showtänzers Rod, um so die Tänzerin Diana zu retten. Diese ist in die Prostitution abgerutscht und hat sich mit HIV infiziert. Zuvor ist sie bei einem Vortanzen abgelehnt worden, weil sie taub ist.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Als Bar-Pianist lebt Sam gefährlich. Er und seine Verflossene geraten ins Visier eines Mörders.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam nimmt die Gestalt von Gilbert Hebert an, um den Mord an seiner Cousine Marsha zu verhindern. Die Prostituierte wurde in Heberts Freudenhaus ums Leben gebracht.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Am 12. April 1974 schlüpft Sam in den Körper von Sänger Geoffrey `Tonic' Mole. Er soll verhindern, dass der Leadsänger der Glitterrock-Band "King Thunder" ermordet wird.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in den Körper des Kopfgeldjägers Gordon O'Reilly. Er soll Diane Frost, der Unterschlagung vorgeworfen wird, dem Sheriff ausliefern. Sam soll die unschuldige Frau vor dem bevorstehenden Tod retten.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist ins Jahr 1955, wo er sich im Körper des Ringers Terry Sammins befindet. Zusammen mit seinem Bruder Ronnie will er um die Weltmeisterschaft kämpfen. Sam soll allerdings Ronnie vom Kampf abhalten, da dieser unter einem Herzfehler leidet.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist in das Jahr 1962 zur Zeit der Kuba-Krise und schlüpft in den Körper von Eddi Elroy. Dieser betreibt mit seinem Bruder Mac einen Handel mit Atombunkern. Sam, alias Eddi, soll Mac davon abhalten, seinen Nachbarn, Burt Rosecranes, umzubringen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in den Körper von Samuel Beederman, um das Schicksal von Tibby positiv zu beeinflussen. Samuel und Tibby sind in einer Nervenheilanstalt in Behandlung. Sam bringt Tibby das Lesen bei.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Dieses Mal tauschen Sam und Albert die Rollen und Sam bleibt als Observer in der Gegenwart. Albert reist ins Jahr 1945, wo er soeben als Kriegsveteran Tom in seinen Heimatort zurückgekehrt ist.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist ins Jahr 1961 und nimmt die Gestalt des Baseballspielers "Doc" Fuller an. Er soll seinen frühzeitigen Tod verhindern und seine Karriere vorantreiben. Fuller hat damals bei einem Unfall einen anderen Spieler umgebracht.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: In der Gestalt von Archie muss Sam im Jahr 1969 Menschen in Jackson Port vor einem Hurrikan retten. Die Bewohner weigern sich allerdings, ihre Wohnungen zu verlassen und wollen stattdessen eine Hurrikan-Party feiern.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam muss als Starfigaro Frank Bianca das Leben des behinderten Sohnes seiner Freundin Laura retten. Der hat beim Einkaufen zufällig einen Mord beobachtet und soll nun umgebracht werden.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in die Gestalt von Katie McBrian, die nach einem Date im Krankenhaus liegt. Sie wurde von Kevin Wentworth brutalst vergewaltigt. Zusammen mit der Anwältin Nancy Hudson will Sam, alias Katie, nun einen Haftbefehl gegen Kevin erwirken.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Janice DeCaro wurde auf brutale Art und Weise in ihrem eigenen Haus ermordet. Ihr wurde der Bauch aufgeschlitzt und das Herz herausgerissen. Unter den Hauptverdächtigen ist ihr Mann Peter, den die Polizisten mit einer Waffe in der Hand antreffen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Billy Beaumont ist ein Scharlatan. Mit der Lüge, Regen herbeizaubern zu können, zieht er den Leuten viel Geld aus der Tasche, mit dem er dann schnell das Weite sucht. Beaumont ist in seinem kleinen Heimatort in Texas zu Besuch bei seiner Mutter.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e seu grupo ainda têm dificuldades em conviver com a população de Alexandria. Uma nova ameaça está prestes a definir o futuro desta relação; Maggie recebe uma missão importante; Rick e Morgan buscam um denominador comum.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Justamente quando parece que as coisas podem enfim voltar ao normal, ou pelo menos tão normal quanto elas possam ser em um apocalipse zumbi, um novo problema surge e impõe novos desafios aos moradores de Alexandria.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e um pequeno grupo enfrentam vários obstáculos tentando voltar para Alexandria. E pode ser que nem todos consigam superar os desafios.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Um integrante de Alexandria descobre que precisa navegar pelo misterioso, confuso e horrendo mundo dos Saviors.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: O clima em Alexandria fica bastante sombrio depois de uma série de contratempos. Isso pode revelar-se demais para os cidadãos abrigados dentro dos portões.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: A suposta paz entre o grupo de Rick e o de Alexandria parece estar chegando a um impasse. Isso porque, quando Daryl, Abraham e Sasha tentam voltar para Alexandria depois de uma missão, eles se deparam com vários obstáculos, incluindo uma nova ameaça.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Após uma série de contratempos, o clima em Alexandria começa finalmente a melhorar. Essa nova configuração parece permitir que haja paz entre o grupo de Rick e o pessoal de Alexandria. O problema, porém, é saber quanto tempo essa paz vai durar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Depois de alguns momentos de uma suposta paz, os problemas voltam a perturbar a ordem em Alexandria. Mas o maior problema é que, dessa vez, a ameaça talvez seja excessivamente grande para ser derrotada.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Enquanto tentam escapar de Alexandria, Rick e seu grupo encontram problemas quando um barulho repentino atrai zumbis em sua direção, trazendo consequências que podem ser fatais.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: O grupo entende que estar do lado dos vivos traz responsabilidades que vão além da sobrevivência. Sob essa ótica, Rick inicia uma luta consigo mesmo para preservar os traços que lhe restam de humanidade.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick fica surpreso ao descobrir que Alexandria não é um lugar tão seguro quanto ele havia imaginado. Com isso, precisa tomar importantes decisões sobre o que fazer e para onde ir.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e o seu grupo percebem que, para manter a paz em Alexandria, é preciso lutar contra um novo inimigo. No entanto, eles também precisam considerar que o maior problema em relação a esse enfrentamento é que, dessa vez, o grupo está em minoria.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Após terem um pequeno sucesso, dois grupos de sobreviventes deixam Alexandria para procurar mantimentos para todos. Embora estejam preocupados com a sobrevivência da comunidade, o sequestro de alguns dos membros faz com que os planos precisem mudar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Dois grupos separados deixam Alexandria em busca de suprimentos. Embora todos estejam preocupados com o futuro da comunidade, o perigo imediato os ameaça. Os caminhos de Daryl e de seu grupo cruzam com os de Dwight.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol desaparece e a comunidade de Alexandria entra em estado de alerta. Preocupado com o que pode acontecer a Carol, Daryl deixa Alexandria em sua motocicleta para procurá-la, mas Glenn não aprova a iniciativa dele.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e o grupo devem sair da cidade para salvar um dos seus. O que eles experimentarão na estrada pode mudar suas vidas para sempre.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Conforme os membros do grupo de Rick permanecem impotentes diante da nova ameaça, Negan entra em ação e Lucille faz uma vítima que vai mudar o rumo das coisas e assombrar para sempre aqueles que sobreviverem.
